privacy_who_b: UZaka wenziwe yiJustIT Solutions (Pty) Ltd (2026/025680/07), ePitoli, eMzantsi Afrika. Sibhaliswe kwi-Information Regulator. Igosa lethu leNgcaciso nguPhenyo Matlou. Qhagamshelana: support@jis-tech.co.za.
privacy_collect_b: I-imeyile yakho negama lokugqitha (eligcinwe njengekhowudi ekhuselekileyo) ukuze ukwazi ukungena. Iinkcukacha zemali ozifakayo (imali, iindidi, imihla, amanqaku, amatyala, iinjongo neesetingi) ukuze uZaka akubonise isicwangciso sakho. KuKhuseleko Lobuqhophololo sigcina kuphela inqanaba lomngcipheko neempawu zesilumkiso ezifunyenweyo, hayi umyalezo. Sibala izicelo ze-AI ukuthintela ukusetyenziswa gwenxa, ngaphandle komxholo wazo.
privacy_never_b: Asisoze sicele okanye sigcine i-PIN yakho yebhanki, amagama okugqitha exesha elinye (ii-OTP) okanye iinkcukacha zokungena ebhankini. UZaka akadibani nebhanki yakho kwaye akasoze athumele mali. Ukuba umisa i-PIN ye-app, ihlala kwifoni yakho njengekhowudi exutyiweyo kwaye ayisoze ithunyelwe kuthi.
privacy_ai_b: Xa usebenzisa u-Yibhale okanye ucela uKhuseleko Lobuqhophololo ukuba luchaze umyalezo, loo mbhalo uthunyelwa ku-Anthropic (Claude, eUnited States) ukuze kwenziwe impendulo. Asiwugcini umbhalo. Susa ii-PIN, iikhowudi neenombolo zeakhawunti ngaphambi kokuncamathelisa umyalezo. Zonke izibalo zemali zenziwa yikhowudi kwifoni yakho, hayi yi-AI.
privacy_where_b: Iakhawunti yakho nezinto ozifakileyo zigcinwa kwi-Supabase eLondon, eUnited Kingdom, zikhuselwe ukuze nguwe kuphela onokuzifunda. Ifoni yakho igcina ikopi ukuze uZaka asebenze ngaphandle kwe-intanethi; ukuphuma kuyayicima.
privacy_keep_b: De uyicime. Mna → Cima idatha yam icima iakhawunti yakho nazo zonke izinto ozifakileyo ngaxeshanye. Iakhawunti yedemo esetyenziswa ngabaninzi inedatha eyenziweyo kuphela.
privacy_rights_b: Unelungelo lokubona, ukulungisa okanye ukucima iinkcukacha zakho, nokuchasa indlela esizisebenzisa ngayo. Thumela i-imeyile ku-support@jis-tech.co.za. Ungakhalaza nakwi-Information Regulator: inforegulator.org.za.
privacy_advice_b: UZaka unika uqikelelo ngokweenkcukacha ozifakayo. Ayilocebiso lwezemali, lwetyala okanye lwezomthetho, kwaye akagqibi ukuba uyakufanelekela na ukufumana ityala. Izigqibo ezibalulekileyo zijonge nomcebisi oqeqeshiweyo.
